warnings.detail: No school has verified current actual bus operation or a verified 2027-academic-year timetable. A 2026 contract ending in February 2027 is not a 2027 academic-year timetable.

The official live post links the 2026-09-15 filename revision. The post publication date, filename revision, older attachment and actual implementation date are distinct. Selected timetable extraction is incomplete network coverage.

The procurement plan prohibits new 2026 entrants from blue-marked stops, but the affected colored stops were not identified. Do not infer any new entrant can use a particular stop. The printed contract end date and a route-time ordering are also contradictory.

The published stop label 경남 현대아파트(2027년 폐쇄) announces a 2027 closure without an exact date. Do not guarantee that stop in 2027. 00:00 values are unavailable placeholders; legacy 12-route material differs from the canonical 14-route pages.

The official homepage-linked route page and script provide 43 direction/day/round variants, not 43 vehicles. Effective school year is not stated; date=261006 is not a verified publication or effective date. Earlier tender details differ.

Homebound values such as 20분 are durations, not clock times. Morning values such as 9호 are route references. Cross-route weekday notes conflict for 서석대, 한티역 and 뱅뱅사거리; no conflict has been silently resolved.
C044 preserves anomalous extracted PM times as a quality issue. They are quarantined and must not be normalized or presented as usable timetable times.
C051 contains malformed extracted source wording (2027월). Printed glyphs were not visually verified. The interpreted 2027-02-28 end is preserved as an inference only; confirmed value.end is null.
A later unread re-tender exists. The original plan of 19 vehicles and attached 2025 route material do not establish final current operation.
An existing PREPPY page is a circular secondary lead, not independent confirmation of new-pupil restrictions or a reported 2029 closure.
Inaccessible or missing evidence does not mean no bus. Unhyun no-bus status is secondary only. No geocoded door-to-door commute ETA, admission eligibility, or seat availability is established.

Stop records include repeated stops, school endpoints, return points and route references. Route variants, numbered routes, vehicles, and unique physical stops are different quantities. No count may be relabelled as another.
